data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 218 experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 22.690 million in 2016, representing 3.97% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by the change in the Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75%, which caused significant deteriorations in long-tail motor liabilities. Other contributing factors included ongoing market inflationary pressures, the depreciation of the pound affecting imported parts, and complexities in bodily injury and PPO settlements. While the Ogden rate change alone resulted in a gross strengthening of GBP 155.750 million, other prior year movements were favourable, partially offsetting this impact to result in the net strengthening.

data.data_quality_notes: The overall prior year development figure of GBP 22.690m strengthening is explicitly stated in the 'Movement in prior accident year's provision for claims outstanding' note. The report also quantifies a gross strengthening of GBP 155.750m due to the Ogden discount rate change, which was applied to the 2016 year-end valuation. This implies significant releases from other prior years offset a large portion of the Ogden impact.
